main_text.p: Fugientes distinctionem personarum quam constituunt Christiani] Ita scil. objiciebant, referente Authore libri Al Mawakef, contra eos qui aeterna Dei attributa adstruebant, قن كفروا النصاري بقدماء [?], Infidelitatis arguuntur Christiani quòd tria statuunt aeterna, quid ergo de iis pronunciandum qui septem aut plura statuunt? Erat fiquidem ipsis اثبات الصفات قول بقدمها [?] مقددة [?] * Idem indubitatâ consequentiâ sequi asserit Maimonides in proleg. ad Pirk: Abofeft. 8.{*}attributa afferere, ac plura aeterna statuere, neque cum iis confistere posse unitatem affirmabant, ad quam quid requirant discimus ex Alsharestanio, قال اهل العدل ان الله تعالى واحد في ذاته لا قسمة له ولا صفة له وواحد في افعاله لا شريك له فلا قديم غير ذاته ولا قسيم في افعاله ومحال وجود قديمين [?] Dicunt illi qui se aequitatis assertores vocant, Deum excelsum unum esse essentiâ suâ, nullam esse ei divisionem, nullam attributum, unum etiam operibus suis, nec socium ipsi esse, nec aeternum alium praeter essentiam ipsius, nec consortem in operibus ipsius, nec fieri posse ut reperiantur duo aeterna, atque hoc (inquiunt) est unitatem afferere. Sententiam suam simpliciter expofuit Al Motazalorum pater Wasel من اثبت معنى وصفة قديمة فقد اثبت الهين [?] i.e. Quicunque afferit significatum, aut attributum aeternum, duos statuit Deos.

P. 18. l. 19.Ex illis etiam qui dicunt ipsum scire per scientiam, quae ipsa essentia ejus est.] Hodailianorum, seu eorum qui Hamdanum AbiHodial, secuti sunt, haec est sententia referente Alsharestanio. Ille siquidem à communiori Al Motazalorum formâ, Deum scire لذاته per essentiam

page.notes: Arabic passages are transcribed from a small, slightly blurred print; words marked [?] are uncertain, especially the vocalised forms and the final words of the Arabic lines. The Latin lemma and the English-style abbreviations were read directly. The catchword "fentiam" was printed with a long s and is given here as "sentiam" under the house rule. The asterisk in the left margin is placed beside the Arabic line "attributa afferere". No printing errors were corrected.
